# Business Requirements Specification

## Functional requirements

**FR-001** — The system shall accept input files.

**FR-002** — The system shall validate mandatory fields.

**FR-003** — The system shall produce a summary report.

**FR-004** — The system shall send email notifications.

**FR-005** — The system shall maintain an audit log.

## Non-functional requirements

| ID | Requirement |
|---|---|
| NFR-001 | Response time under 2 seconds |
| NFR-002 | 99.9% availability |
